title: AI POD shared network primitives
description: Reusable type definitions for IP addresses, CIDR blocks, hostnames, ASNs, and VLAN IDs. Referenced by every subsystem schema so validation behavior is identical across the AI POD.

ipv4.description: IPv4 address in dotted-decimal notation (e.g. 203.0.113.7). The format keyword adds semantic validation when supported.

ipv4_cidr.description: IPv4 address followed by /prefix (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24). Prefix range 0-32.

ipv4_prefix_length.description: IPv4 prefix length (network mask in bits). Typically 16-30 for AI POD networks.

fqdn.description: Fully qualified or single-label DNS name.

hostname_or_ipv4.description: Either a DNS name or an IPv4 literal. Used where DNS is optional (e.g. NTP server). anyOf (not oneOf) because pure-numeric labels like 10.115.0.20 are technically valid per the FQDN regex; we accept either interpretation.

asn_2byte.description: 2-byte BGP ASN. Use asn_4byte for 4-byte ASNs.

url_http.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL. Use this for ISO mirrors and similar.

sha512_hex.description: SHA-512 digest in lowercase or uppercase hex (128 chars).
